mzi-sat-1.webp.zh: 卫星视角：莫普提机场（MZI）位于干旱地表与裸地之中。
mzi-sat-1.webp.en: Satellite view: Mopti Airport (MZI) lies among dry ground and bare land.

mzi-chatgpt-01.webp.zh: 棕榈树下，米黄色航站楼的墙面上写着莫普提机场的字样，旅客在红土场地上等候。
mzi-chatgpt-01.webp.en: Under a tall palm, the cream terminal building carries a sign reading Aeroport de Mopti Hambodedjo, with travellers waiting on the red earth outside.

mzi-chatgpt-02.webp.zh: 一架白色双发涡桨客机停在浅灰色停机坪上，旅客步行登机，远处是枯黄的原野。
mzi-chatgpt-02.webp.en: A white twin-engine turboprop stands on the pale apron while passengers walk out to board it, with dry scrub stretching to the horizon.

mzi-chatgpt-03.webp.zh: 航站楼入口上方标着国际到达与出发，门前停着白色皮卡，几名戴蓝色贝雷帽的士兵站在一旁。
mzi-chatgpt-03.webp.en: Above the terminal entrance, signs read arrival and departure in French and English, with white pick-ups parked outside and blue-bereted soldiers standing nearby.

mzi-chatgpt-04.webp.zh: 晴朗蓝天下一架白色双发涡桨客机侧身停在停机坪上，机身后方有一棵棕榈树和矮矮的候机楼。
mzi-chatgpt-04.webp.en: Under a clear blue sky, a white twin turboprop with a blue cheatline sits side-on at the apron, a palm tree and low terminal building behind it.

mzi-chatgpt-05.webp.zh: 旅客背着行囊走向停在红褐色停机坪上的小型双发涡桨飞机，旁边一辆油罐车正在作业。
mzi-chatgpt-05.webp.en: Travellers in sun hats walk toward a small twin turboprop on the reddish apron while a fuel truck waits beside it.

mzi-chatgpt-06.webp.zh: 雾白的天空下，一名士兵站在石灰地面上，注视着一架土黄色双发涡桨飞机滑行。
mzi-chatgpt-06.webp.en: In flat white haze, a soldier in camouflage stands on the concrete watching a sandy-yellow twin turboprop move across the apron.

mzi-chatgpt-07.webp.zh: 一架尾翼带绿色标志的客机停在远处，成堆的行李铺在干硬的地面上，装卸工正把它们码上拖车。
mzi-chatgpt-07.webp.en: A jet with a green tail emblem waits beyond a spread of luggage laid out on dry ground, where baggage handlers stack bags onto a cart.
